scope: does a per-call host identity reach the bridge, and is a borrowed overlay refused

design.what_was_missing: the stock @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client calls client.callTool({name, arguments}) with no _meta, so the bridge cannot tell which conversation is calling
design.where_the_identity_comes_from: exec.agent.session.id, inside the harness process, for that call. Measured in the feasibility step - see host-identity-source.json
design.how_it_travels: a minimal host provider registers the same tools over the same stdio MCP server and adds _meta[<key>] to every tools/call
design.why_no_shared_change_is_needed: the bridge already requires and digests _meta[TSUNAGOU_HOST_META_KEY] when it is declared: `conversation_metadata_required` when absent, and it routes each conversation to its own stateDir/sessions/bridge-session-<digest>.json. That path was built for OpenCode; DeepSeek never declared the key
design.codex_and_opencode: untouched: the gate is the adapter's own overlay declaring the key

enrolled_conversation.result: agent beb92813-f2c6-47ef-ae5c-3f0da5d0f439, Tsunagou session fe7df5f9-0030-41b0-a3c7-e828ef493ef2, connection_epoch 3
enrolled_conversation.reading: the live session id was delivered per call and the enrolled identity executed the business call

new_conversation_same_overlay.reading: the borrowed overlay did NOT yield the enrolled identity: the new conversation is routed by its own session digest to a private session file that holds no credential. This is the R1 counterexample, closed at the routing level

measured.first_positive_attempt_failed_for_an_env: the first positive run returned bridge_request_failed because the coordination daemon was stopped; after `tsunagou daemon start` the same command returned the enrolled identity. Recorded so the failed run is not mistaken for a routing defect - it did not answer not_enrolled, so routing had already succeeded.

not_yet_done: the overlay generator still names the stock client, and does not declare TSUNAGOU_HOST_META_KEY
the provider package is not installed into the host profile by `agent connect`

those three changes are inseparable - the new name without the install fails to load, and the key without the provider turns every call into conversation_metadata_required - so they were reverted rather than left half-landed
agent connect/bootstrap and the Codex/OpenCode regressions were therefore not re-run against the new wiring

product_files_state.reading: src/ is unchanged by this attempt; the seven already-pending files are as they were

redaction_note: The raw enrolled host session_arg was replaced with its existing digest during independent review; original backed up outside the repository. Observation results are unchanged.
